findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which severely delays your cash flow and leaves you waiting three months to be paid for completed work.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30 from receipt of invoice.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the paperwork. Before signing the agreement, I have one quick request. - Regarding the relevant clause, payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which severely delays your cash flow and leaves you waiting three months to be paid for completed work, and I propose changing this to: Invoices are payable Net 30 from receipt of invoice. Thank you for your understanding and best regards.
